task.description:
Execute test suite for AGT-05, AGT-06, AGT-07 on branch feature/WF02-agt05-07-20260819.

1. git checkout feature/WF02-agt05-07-20260819 && git pull
2. zig build migrate
3. zig build test (unit tests — must pass)
4. Run: zig build test-integration-agt05-07
   Expected: 17/17 tests pass
5. Run full regression suite to check no regressions

Write test report to: tests/reports/WF02-agt05-07-20260819-test-report.yaml

Return PASS or FAIL.
